parameters.query:
select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.status,
  r.resolution,
  r.duration_seconds,
  r.cover_image_url,
  r.render_log
from content_items ci
join renders r on r.content_id = ci.content_id
where ci.status = 'render_queued'
  and r.render_status = 'queued'
order by ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

update renders
set render_status = '{{$json.next_render_status_sql}}',
    output_video_url = nullif('{{$json.output_video_url_sql}}', ''),
    cover_image_url = coalesce(nullif('{{$json.cover_image_url_sql}}', ''), cover_image_url),
    duration_seconds = case when {{$json.duration_seconds_sql}} > 0 then {{$json.duration_seconds_sql}} else duration_seconds end,
    resolution = coalesce(nullif('{{$json.resolution_sql}}', ''), resolution),
    render_log = case
      when nullif('{{$json.render_log_sql}}', '') is not null then '{{$json.render_log_sql}}'
      else render_log
    end,
    completed_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
returning content_id, render_status, output_video_url, cover_image_url, duration_seconds, resolution, completed_at;

update content_items
set status = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["next_content_status_sql"]}}',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["next_render_status_sql"] == "success" ? "success" : "failed"}}',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["error_message_sql"]}}', ''),
  jsonb_build_object(
    'render_callback', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Callback SQL Values"].json["callback_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
